xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AnyOtherInformationForDisclosu: For point 1, the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on March 12, 2025 had approved the proposal to increase the limits of investment in its wholly owned subsidiary, ICICI Prudential Pension Funds Management Company Limited, from Rs.750 million to Rs.1000 million. For point 2, On February 7, 2025, the Company acquired 10,000 equity shares with a face value of Rs. 10 each, amounting to Rs. 1 Lakh, for which an intimation was made to the exchanges on December 5, 2023, representing an 8.33% stake when paid-up capital of Bima Sugam India Federation (BSIF) was 1,20,000 equity shares. For point 3, On March 15, 2025, the Company further acquired 65.9 lakh equity shares with a face value of Rs. 10 each amounting to Rs. 6.59 Crores, for which an intimation was made to the exchanges on November 21, 2024. While the corresponding increase in the paid-up capital of BISF was from 1,20,000 to 33,00,00,000 equity shares. As a result of dilution, the Companys holding in BSIF at the quarter-end stands at 2%.
